property-disallowed-list.message: Use logical properties (inline-start/inline-end) so layouts work in right-to-left languages.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Use start/end or inline-start/inline-end so layouts work in right-to-left languages.

color-no-hex.message: Use a --tb-color-* token (spec 033 T010); raw colors cannot follow the tenant theme.

unit-disallowed-list.message: Use a --tb-space-*, --tb-font-size-*, --tb-radius-* or --tb-border-width-* token (spec 033 T010), or rem for layout breakpoints.
